stemMd: A warehouse uses only electric or diesel forklifts. Every electric forklift is assigned indoors. Forklift Rowan is assigned outdoors. Which conclusion follows?

options.label: A
options.textMd: Rowan has lower running costs than indoor forklifts.

options.label: D
options.textMd: No electric forklift is ever used.

explanationMd: Outdoor assignment excludes electric status by contraposition. Since the two fuel categories exhaust the warehouse fleet, Rowan must be diesel.

distractorRationale.d: The assignment rule does not imply nonexistence.
distractorRationale.c: The rule does not exclude indoor diesel forklifts.
distractorRationale.e: No rule assigns all diesel machines outdoors.
